The '''Flurry''' was a [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] produced by [[Orlean]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].
